title: Spring $$2023$$ Midterm
body: Selected questions from the Spring $$2023$$ Midterm. Q6 concerns modeling, loss functions, and their optimal parameters. Q7: Narges builds a flight delay linear regression model. The dataset has $$400$$ flight records and $$10$$ columns (1 is the observed delay in minutes; $$9$$ are non-constant numerical features). Assume the least squares estimate is $$\hat{\theta} $$=$$ (X**TX)**{-1}X**TY$$ for design matrix $$X$$ (with intercept) and true output vector $$Y$$.
